name: marketing-contact-forms
title: Contact Forms
description: Lead capture and inquiry forms for marketing websites, with base, triage-category, checkbox-consent, grid-layout, and side-by-side-with-description variants for contacting sales, support, or general inquiries.
useWhen: Capturing sales leads or support inquiries on a marketing website contact page.
Collecting user categorization (triage) before routing to the right team via subject-line or category selection.
Presenting a form alongside company contact details (address, phone, map) in a split layout.
avoidWhen: Complex multi-step qualification flows — use a wizard or multi-step form component instead.
Authentication or account forms — use dedicated login/signup components.
The primary goal is newsletter subscription — use newsletter-signup components instead.
responsiveBehavior: Side-by-side layouts with description collapse to stacked single-column on mobile. Grid layouts reflow from two-column to single-column field layout on small screens.
accessibility: Every form field must have a visible <label> element linked by for/id.
Required fields must be indicated both visually (asterisk) and programmatically (required attribute or aria-required).
Error messages must be linked to their field via aria-describedby and not communicated by color alone.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Standard contact form with name, email, subject, and message fields — the minimal pattern for marketing contact pages.
accessibility: All fields must have linked <label> elements; submit button label clearly describes the action.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Standard contact form adapted for dark marketing surfaces with dark input backgrounds and light labels.
accessibility: Input text, labels, and placeholder text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark input backgrounds.

variants.title: Base with triage
variants.description: Contact form with a subject-type or department selector to route inquiries to the right team — sales, support, press, or partnerships.
accessibility: Triage select must have a linked label; selected option value is announced when changed.

variants.title: Base with triage (Dark)
variants.description: Triage contact form adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Select input and label must meet contrast requirements on dark form backgrounds.

variants.title: Base with checkboxes
variants.description: Contact form with checkbox consent fields for GDPR marketing consent, privacy policy acceptance, or inquiry type selection.
accessibility: Checkbox groups must be wrapped in <fieldset>/<legend>; each checkbox must have a linked <label>.

variants.title: Base with checkboxes (Dark)
variants.description: Checkbox-consent contact form adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Checkbox indicators and labels must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark form backgrounds.

variants.title: Grid
variants.description: Two-column grid form layout placing first name, last name, email, and phone side by side — reduces vertical height for longer contact forms.
accessibility: Grid layout does not change semantic requirements — each field still needs a linked label.

variants.title: Grid (Dark)
variants.description: Two-column grid contact form adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: All input fields in the grid must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Side-by-side form with description
variants.description: Split layout with a company description, contact details, and social links on the left and the form on the right — for contact pages that need to communicate trust before form submission.
accessibility: Form section must be a distinct landmark; description column and form column stack on mobile.

variants.title: Side-by-side form with description (Dark)
variants.description: Split description-and-form contact layout adapted for dark marketing surfaces.
accessibility: Description text and form inputs must both meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
